correctness.rationale: Exact joint moments are obtained from disjoint vertex tuples and q^(-sum s_i*s_j) edge-corrections, with R_n(s) factorial ratios. Taking the third joint cumulant cancels order 0 and 1/n, while direct independent SymPy series computes the n^-2 coefficient abc[(a+b+c)(lambda-1)^2-1]. Distinct nonempty disjoint families ensure no multiple counting, even for equal orders; fixed positive lambda and n>=a+b+c. The two simple positive roots follow by locally uniform derivative expansions, not by finite sampling. A separate symbolic expansion reproduced the coefficient exactly.

Asymptotic roots locally unique only; not global finite-n zeros.
No generality claimed for growing component orders.
